name: Evidence Interaction Hinge
ascii:
Legend: `[D]` = grounded data/state, `(O)` = user-visible operation.

                         EVIDENCE-CENTERED INVESTIGATION

 (O) Mapped Representation Element
       | `AsciiSelectionGrid` mapping button: Evidence tooltip + source location
       | `App.revealCodeEntity(mapping)`: entity + source-range index
       v
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [D] Evidence Interaction Hinge                                                           |
|     `REPOSITORY_DIAGRAM_DECOMPOSITION.md` E1: Representation -> Evidence -> Corpus       |
|                                                                                          |
|              EVIDENCE / CODEENTITY COMPATIBILITY BOUNDARY                                |
|  +--------------------------------------+       +--------------------------------------+  |
|  | [D] EvidenceEntity                   |<=====>| [D] CodeEntityRecord                 |  |
|  | id / handle / label / kind / summary |       | persisted compatibility shape        |  |
|  | SourceRange anchors                  |       | `src/domain.ts`                      |  |
|  +--------------------------------------+       +--------------------------------------+  |
|       `src/domainProfile.ts EvidenceSchema.fromCodeEntity` adapter                       |
|                                                                                          |
| (O) Inspect Evidence and Choose Range                                                     |
|     `src/components/CodeEntitiesPanel.tsx`: metadata + `path:line` controls              |
|     `src/referenceResolver.ts resolveReference`: stable sourceRangeId preferred          |
|     range index remains legacy-compatible; requested range becomes the jump target       |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
       |
       | active Evidence entity / chosen SourceRange
       v
 (O) Authoritative Corpus Reveal
       | `CodeEntitiesPanel` -> `server/application.ts Application.sourceSnippet`
       |
       v
 [D] Authoritative Corpus Passage
       validate range; read project document; overlay anchored immutable snapshot
       render source or Markdown

 (O) Explicit Corpus Browse ----------------------------------------------> [D] Corpus
       allowed direct access; not the mapped-Representation grounding path

                         EVIDENCE INTERACTION FAN

 From the hinge: Evidence identity plus chosen SourceRange
       |
       +---- visual rectangle ----> (O) Rectangle Selection into Reference Buffer
       |       `DiagramView.completeSelection`; `refBuffer.referenceFromMapping`
       |       ReferenceIdentity -> DiagramSet RefBuffer: copy | token | dispatch | remove | clear
       |
       +---- saved mapping -------> [D] Persistent Evidence-backed Highlight
       |       `highlights.ts HighlightRecordV2`; `Application.addHighlight`
       |       artifact revision + stable element -> Evidence/range + excerpt + lineage
       |
       +---- normalized path -----> [D] File / Evidence Associations
       |       `fileTree.ts diagramFileFilter`; `FileExplorerPanel`
       |       project-local Evidence rows reveal their exact source ranges
       |
       +---- selected refs -------> (O) Selected Evidence Call Graph Focus
       |       `createCallGraphFocusRequest`; `RefBufferTray.displayCallGraph`
       |       validate both artifacts; retain matching nodes, ancestors, and provenance
       |
       '- - no current action - - > (O) Universal Evidence-to-All-Representations Navigation
               `RepresentationIndex.resolveEvidence <-> resolveElement` supports lookup
               FUTURE: no universal `CodeEntitiesPanel` action exists today
